name: Visa Acceptance Solutions (SMB)
author: Visa Acceptance Solutions

sections.description:
This plugin integrates Visa Acceptance Solutions (SMB) into your WooCommerce store, offering multiple payment methods such as Card Payments, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Click to Pay, Paze, eCheck/ACH, PayPal and Venmo.
Securely store customer payment details with our Token Management Service.
Fraud Management handling built in.
Compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions

Privacy Policy and Terms of Service

Refer to Terms of Service
Refer to Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire “visa-acceptance-smb” folder to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory in your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings in WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Visa Acceptance Solutions (SMB).

For full documentation, please visit our documentation center
sections.faq:
How can I test credit card transactions?

Configure Plugin in “Test” Environment. Then submit an order with valid billing address and payment information according to our test documentation

How can I test 3D Secure authentication?

Configure Plugin in “Test” Environment. Then submit an order with valid billing address, additional min required fields and payment information according to our 3D Secure Test documentation.

What are the required credentials to set up the plugin?

You’ll need your Visa Acceptance Solutions Merchant ID, API Key ID, Shared Secret Key and Response MLE certificate. For production, you’ll need production credentials, and for testing, you’ll need test credentials from your Visa Acceptance Solutions (SMB) account. Please visit Support or contact your reseller.

How do I get support with this plugin?

In most cases we can provide support through the WordPress or WooCommerce forums. In some cases we may need you to contact our Support Team or your reseller, if some information is required that should not be in the public domain.

How can I get a sandbox account?

Sign up here. Note sandbox accounts are configured for USD currency
